fact: Pidió en la Comunidad de diseño independiente el párrafo que Luis usa en sus cotizaciones para distinguir una corrección de un cambio de composición del menú; él todavía no se lo comparte.
Is helping Ben with the upstairs room layout at The Eel & Anchor for Jo’s surprise party. Luis asked her to measure the wall by the fireplace for his 140 cm screen.
Plans to serve his usual almond sponge with three pears at the November 2026 book club meeting at his house.

Found the €30 cash deposit for the spare Blue Room key from Luis and Niamh’s September stay. On 7 October 2026 she put the €30 in the staff jar at Luis’s request after he declined €40 towards a future booking.
Handles Luis’s desk lamp claim HAL-2026-063812. The lamp cost £145 and Luis promised to send two overlapping receipt photos by 24 October 2026.
Stayed with Luis and Niamh at Albion Road in the week of 6 April 2026 and picked up a parcel of theirs from the lobby on Tuesday 7 April.
Runs a Tuesday evening stretch class at St Jude’s hall, straight after the book club when it meets there. Her flat is in Hackney council tax Band C (£1,724 for 2025/26).
Holds the book club’s booking at St Jude’s hall and keeps the subs in a biscuit tin; the club met there on Tuesday 29 September 2026.

In October 2026 found a brass key with a white notched collar (B or 8) in his umbrella stand, possibly Luis’s missing bike store key; Luis had returned a book to him in September. He suggested Tuesday 27 October after four to compare it with Luis’s spare.
